name: Inami Misuzu
source:
One of the three girls who bullied the protagonist's younger sister.
She has a strong desire for self-expression and has longed to enter the entertainment world since she was a little girl. A few months ago, after becoming famous as a magazine model, she made her long-awaited debut in the entertainment industry and is now attracting attention as a new fashion leader among young people. Her main activities consist of modeling and being a gravure idol.
Due to her popularity, she plans to work as a fashion designer in the near future. Because she dresses up and makes herself look good, she is afraid of exposing her ugly parts and complexes and losing her fame, position, and popularity.
